plan.notes: Source: UCI General Catalogue 2026-27, Computer Science, B.S. page (catalogue.uci.edu/donaldbrenschoolofinformationandcomputersciences/departmentofcomputerscience/computerscience_bs/). Transcribed by hand from the official 4-year sample program (Fall/Winter/Spring quarter tables) published for this exact program — a genuine official term-by-term sequence. Course titles and quarter-unit values verified against the official catalog course descriptions (I&C SCI, COMPSCI, SWE, MATH, STATS, WRITING course lists). Credit notes: I&C SCI 51 and I&C SCI 53 are 6 units each in the 2026-27 catalog; all other listed courses are 4 units. Choice slots (General Education, Flex Core, Computer Science Elective, Science Elective) are entered as choice:true placeholders at 4 units each (standard GE/upper-division unit value; actual GE course units may vary 2-5). Prereq arrays left empty: the official sample program does not list per-slot prerequisites (sequencing is encoded in the quarter ordering; true prereqs are published in the catalog course descriptions). Degree-requirement caveat: UCI requires 180 quarter units for the B.S., but the official sample program's own Note 1 says it 'lists the minimum requirements; it is possible that students may have to take additional courses to prepare for required courses' — the transcribed sequence sums to 176 units, so total_credits is set to the plan's actual sum (176); students fill the remaining ~4 units with additional courses to reach 180. 12 quarters (4 years), 43 slots, 0 console errors concept not applicable (static JSON).
